finePrint.summary: Monthly AI credits are capped by plan, which limits how much a lifetime-deal buyer could generate without buying more.

quote.text: Each action costs credits. Plus gives you 1,000/month, Pro 5,000/month, Ultra 25,000/month.

finePrint.summary: Unused subscription credits expire monthly, so a buyer cannot bank unused generation capacity.

quote.text: Yes, unused subscription credits expire after a month.

finePrint.summary: Only Pro credits roll over and only for 3 months, so long-term accumulation is limited.

quote.text: Pro plan credits roll over for up to 3 months.

finePrint.summary: Subscriptions have only a 7-day money-back guarantee with conditions for lifetime-deal buyers to check.

quote.text: We offer a 7-day money-back guarantee on subscription purchases, subject to the following conditions:

finePrint.summary: A refund requires using less than half the billing period credits, limiting heavy trial use.

quote.text: You must have used less than 50% of the credits allocated for that billing period

finePrint.summary: Only the first purchase is refundable and renewals are non-refundable, which matters for recurring billing.

quote.text: The 7-day refund window applies only to your initial subscription purchase on the platform.

finePrint.summary: The vendor can change pricing at any time, so a deal price may not predict future costs.

quote.text: We may change our pricing at any time.

finePrint.summary: Features can be modified or discontinued at the vendor's discretion, risking lifetime-deal value.

quote.text: Modify, update, or discontinue features at our discretion

finePrint.summary: Credit costs and feature availability can be changed with only reasonable notice.

quote.text: Change credit costs or feature availability with reasonable notice

finePrint.summary: Accounts violating rules can be suspended or terminated without notice or refund.

quote.text: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate accounts that violate these rules without prior notice or refund.

finePrint.summary: The vendor may suspend or terminate accounts for violations, fraud, or legal reasons.

quote.text: We may suspend or terminate your account if you violate these Terms, engage in fraudulent activity, or if required by law.

finePrint.summary: Serious violations can lead to immediate termination without refund, ending access.

quote.text: In cases of serious violations, termination may be immediate and without refund.

finePrint.summary: The normal yearly-discounted prices are $12, $30 and $120 per month, providing a baseline to compare a lifetime deal.

quote.text: Yes! Pay yearly and save up to $250. Plus: $12/mo (instead of $20), Pro: $30/mo (instead of $50), Ultra: $120/mo (instead of $200).

trials.claimQuote:
Get lifetime access to AIWriteBook
- All future Plus (Tier 1), Pro (Tiers 2-4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: Buyers confirm holding and valuing the lifetime deal; the generic termination and feature-change terms do not show lifetime buyers are being ended or moved off it.

exhibits.quote: Upon termination, your right to use the Service ends immediately.
exhibits.argument: Lifetime access ends immediately on termination, so it is not unconditional lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: - Modify, update, or discontinue features at our discretion
exhibits.argument: Vendor can discontinue features at discretion, undermining guaranteed lifetime access to all features.

exhibits.quote: I had this before the APP sumo deal, and so lifetime is wonderful!
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms they hold a lifetime license from the AppSumo deal.

exhibits.quote: lowk the lifetime deal is so worth it ngl
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the purchase is a lifetime deal and endorses its value.

trials.claim: Professional book covers with unlimited variations
trials.claimQuote: Design professional book covers with unlimited variations until you find the right look
trials.reasoning: Each book cover generation costs 30 credits, so variations are credit-limited rather than unlimited.

exhibits.quote:
- Illustration generation: 15 credits

- Book cover generation: 30 credits
exhibits.argument: Each cover costs 30 credits, so variations are not unlimited.

exhibits.quote:
Book Cover

30 credits

Generate 1 book cover
exhibits.argument: Pricing confirms one generation costs 30 credits, contradicting unlimited variations.

exhibits.quote: Make a cover on the book's Metadata step or with the standalone cover generator, in 21 art styles, with the title and author name drawn into the artwork.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states it provides a cover generator with 21 art styles and title rendering.

exhibits.quote: the quality of the book covers that have been generated are great.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the generated book covers are of great quality.

trials.claimQuote:
Access to future AI models may require an add on
- 500 per month Credits
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show the regular Plus plan amount and audiobook credit costs, but neither proves or disproves that deal Tier 1 itself provides 500 credits per month.

exhibits.quote: Plus Plan: $20/month (or $12/month billed annually) with 1,000 credits monthly
exhibits.argument: Official Plus plan gives 1,000 credits monthly, double the 500 claimed for Tier 1.

exhibits.quote: Audiobook narration in the Audiobook Studio: 1 credit per 12.5 characters of text, plus 20% when multi-voice character casting is on (a 2,000-word chapter is roughly 880 credits single-voice)
exhibits.argument: One audiobook chapter alone costs ~880 credits, exceeding the entire 500 monthly allowance.

trials.claim: Tier 2 includes 1,000 credits per month plus audiobook studio, author page, and NSFW support
trials.claimQuote:
1,000 per month Credits
- Audiobook studio
- Author page
- NSFW books supported
trials.reasoning: Buyers report NSFW books are not actually supported and generation is refused even with the Dubious option, materially contradicting the NSFW part of the Tier 2 claim.

exhibits.quote: Major downside is that it says that NSFW books are supported when it doesn't.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports NSFW support claim is misleading and untrue in practice.

exhibits.quote: Half of the time the AI refuses to generate characters/outlines/content, even when the Dubious option is selected.
exhibits.argument: AI refusal shows NSFW support fails even with explicit setting enabled.

exhibits.quote: Each action costs credits. Plus gives you 1,000/month, Pro 5,000/month, Ultra 25,000/month.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the 1,000 credits per month credit amount.

exhibits.quote: The Audiobook Studio reads a chapter, works out who speaks each line and proposes a voice for every character next to your narrator.
exhibits.argument: Vendor confirms the Audiobook Studio feature exists as described.

trials.claim: All future Plus and Pro plan updates included
trials.claimQuote: All future Plus (Tier 1), Pro (Tiers 2-4) plan updates
trials.reasoning: The binding terms reserve the right to discontinue features and change credit costs or feature availability, materially limiting the promise that all future Plus and Pro updates are included.

exhibits.quote: - Modify, update, or discontinue features at our discretion
exhibits.argument: Vendor reserves right to discontinue features, contradicting promise of all future updates.

exhibits.quote: - Change credit costs or feature availability with reasonable notice
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change costs and availability, so future plan updates are not guaranteed as sold.

trials.claimQuote:
License Tier 1: $79 (was $144)
- Get lifetime access to AIWriteBook
trials.reasoning: Vendor pricing shows Plus at $12 per month billed yearly, totaling $144, which matches the claimed was price; no exhibit shows deal buyers being charged a different Tier 1 price.

exhibits.quote: Plus Plan: $20/month (or $12/month billed annually) with 1,000 credits monthly
exhibits.argument: $144 equals the normal annual subscription price, making was $144 misleading as a lifetime discount.

exhibits.quote: We may change our pricing at any time.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can change pricing anytime, undermining fixed was-price discount claim.

exhibits.quote: Pay yearly and save up to $250. Plus: $12/mo (instead of $20), Pro: $30/mo (instead of $50), Ultra: $120/mo (instead of $200).
exhibits.argument: Vendor pricing shows Plus at $12 per month yearly, which equals $144 per year matching the claimed was price.
